description: Rejects simplicial cochain evaluations where 1-cochains are treated as symmetric rather than alternating under edge reversal.
negative_fixture: The 1-cochain is symmetric so omega(u, v) = omega(v, u), making the 3-cycle circulation vanish.
positive_fixture: Alternating parity omega(v, u) = -omega(u, v) establishes cycle circulation Gamma = 12133/5000 > 0.
